justifications.fit: the added names (accepts_keyword, the session parameter) read as mechanism, the deferred imports at reckon/crew_follow_commands.py:108 match the module idiom, and no plan or ticket label appears in the diff.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/resumption.py:1704 filters the resume pass on pointer['session'] and resumption.py:1905 forwards session= to the reflex, which is exactly the goal, with the session-less fleet sweep left unconfined by design.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/runs.py:32 is the one owner of the keyword-acceptance capability and both sites (reckon/crew/dispatch_picker.py:445, reckon/crew_follow_commands.py:1705) now call it rather than forking it; no other owner exists (reckon/mcp_deadlines.py:461 resolves annotations, a different capability).
justifications.scope_discipline: reckon/crew/runs.py:32 sits outside the node's declared write_paths although the coordinator's resume advice authorised a shared module and accepted reckon/crew/dispatch_picker.py.
